_rule: Prepared BEFORE the run (AGENTS.md). STAGED, not queued, not authorized. One Water Queens House (S8) launch, Ultra with fg=3, the RTX Hair On bundle of 2026-11-14 (rt_hair_header_cam_gpu=1 inside it), rt_hair_card_fill=1 and rt_hair_dense_sample=1 compiled into the strand pipelines at startup, detailed logging. The fill is toggled inside the run by its header flag.
observable: Under the fast wheel dolly (hl1's 'lower', 10 notches) and a slow orbit: (1) does any card-marked hair pixel stay empty and does any head switch to cards with the card fill on; (2) what the pixels that keep no strand say about the remaining loss (dense samples).
windows: warmup 20 s (fill 1), warm-off 3 s (fill 0), warm-on 3 s (fill 1); in-fill (wheel +10, 240 frames), watch-fill (360 frames), out-fill (wheel -10, 240 frames), settle-off 3 s (fill 0), in-off (wheel +10, 240 frames, fill 0), watch-off (240 frames, fill 0), settle-on 3 s (fill 1), orbit-r and orbit-l (fill 1). One PNG trace 0.9 s into in-fill and in-off.

part1_card_fill.predicted_fill_on: in-fill, watch-fill, out-fill, orbit-r, orbit-l: every 'switches' period line has 'frame watchdog 0, key watchdog 0, coverage low 0' (the dolly's loss lasts 5-7 frames, under the 28 measurements a swapping key needs); frame watchdog lines may appear (5-7 expected in in-fill, as hl1 003637) and say 'cards for 0 frames'; the PNG of in-fill shows hair on every head, strands where the trace held and card texture elsewhere, no see-through to the scalp or background.
part1_card_fill.predicted_fill_off: in-off: the state of hl1 003637: 5-7 frame watchdog lines 'cards for 28 frames', the switches line with 'frame watchdog' 1 or more, the PNG may show holes on the far heads.
part1_card_fill.cost: strand G-buffer GPU ms in watch-fill within 0.02 ms of watch-off (003637: 0.206 ms): the fill runs only on card pixels without a strand (3-7% when still).
part1_card_fill.energy: not an energy-neutral change by design: a pixel that was a hole (scalp or background) becomes hair. Still camera: the share of such pixels is 1 - S/C = 3-7% of the card pixels.
part1_card_fill.if_switches_with_fill: a 'coverage low' switch in a fill window means a loss longer than 28 measurements: read the dense samples of that key; the fill still shows cards there.
part1_card_fill.if_look_wrong_when_still: watch-fill against watch-off: if the still hair looks like cards (the fill covers more than gaps), the 'behind the strand' depth loses against the strand's own fragment: compare the dense samples' accepted share (it must not drop with the fill on: the fill never clears an accepted word).

part2_remaining_loss.known: hl1 000345 and 003637 (rt_hair_header_cam_gpu=1): rebase origin 0 in every sample, header, TLAS, points and BLASes of one build (build stamp), still 30-50% of the strand pixels lost while the camera moves 0.4-1.3 m per frame, all or nothing per draw, the far LOD 2 heads first. Offline 2026-11-14 (tests/hair_primary_gpu_test.py refit_check): an in-place refit of a compacted LSS BLAS under 0.5-1.3 m per frame translation shows the strands of a fresh build, so the refit is not it.
part2_remaining_loss.reading: all or nothing per draw with equal head sizes near and far points at the groom's points of that frame (one draw's update), not at the rays or the acceleration structure. The dense sample of a failing draw decides: its anchor (the row's first point, put in the world with the G-buffer camera the GPU read) against the same key's anchor of the frame before.

candidates.P1. the draw's points were not rewritten: anchor moved in the world by the camera step of that frame (same length, within centimetres) on the failing keys, 0 on the others; reason 'no strand on the ray' or 'outside the card band' with |hit - card| near the step. Fix: hair_groom_update keeps a point only with its camera (rebase kept points by the camera delta), or the row leaves the publish that frame.
candidates.P2. the draw's card triangles in the pre: anchor at the camera (|anchor| under 0.1 m while the card is metres away) or on one vertex, reason 'no strand on the ray'; the same keys recover the next still frame. Fix: the update counts collapsed triangles and the row is published without its key that frame (card mode), or the groom keeps its last valid points rebased.
candidates.P3. points rotated about the camera (a v: anchor drift grows with the card distance (metres x radians), 'ray against view x projection' over 0.1 mrad on moving frames. Fix: the conversion's camera block is copied on the GPU at the capture.
candidates.P4. the game's own LOD change at the zoo: rejects only on keys first drawn under 10 frames before; the other keys accepted.
candidates.P5. trace or acceleration structure: 'no strand on the ray' with the anchor still (millimetres), origin 0 and the card as near its anchor as when still. The refit itself is excluded offline; left would be the TLAS instance data.
candidates.P6. slot or key map of another publish: 'strand of another draw' for whole draws, anchors still.

part2_remaining_loss.decision: the moving-side line of '[hair primary] dense samples' and the per-sample lines of in-fill and in-off name the reason and the anchor drift per key: exactly one of P1-P6 fits; none fitting is also a result (then the sample lacks the field that matters, name it).
part2_remaining_loss.not_gated: the trips and the reasons are reported; the run is VALID with or without holes.

target: the user's target is strands in every frame, also under fast camera motion. This run does not prove that: it proves the safety net (no hole, no whole-head switch) and names the cause of the remaining loss. The fix of that cause follows from the candidate confirmed and needs its own short rerun of in-off.
